final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, total_spent / (SELECT SUM(total_spent) FROM customer_totals) AS share FROM customer_totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.total_spent) AS average_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG((s.share - a.value) / a.value) AS average_relative_difference FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.value
